target: myers_step: shorter loop-carried critical path on Apple Silicon (aarch64::apple)
hypothesis: Shift before the add (S = (E & P) + P with E = eq << 1, P = vp << 1) and write each output as a two-op select on S: chain 6 -> 5 at 18 ops (was 15), up to ~1/6 less time per column on patterns <= 64 chars.

benchmark_by_length (A1 B1 A2 B2, B/A of.len 16: ascii 1.050/1.042, latin1 1.035/1.029, cjk 1.035/1.030, emoji 1.044/1.033 (IQRs separate: loss)
benchmark_by_length (A1 B1 A2 B2, B/A of.len 32-512: within noise on all kinds (rapidfuzz drift 0.95-1.03)

reason: Wins only one microbenchmark (ASCII long text, ~-4.5%) and loses 3-5% at length 16. About 1.97 ns (~7 cycles at 3.5 GHz) per column with a 6-op chain means the column loop is not limited by the step chain alone; profile what else bounds it before shortening the chain further.

analysis.profile (samply, ascii/cjk 32|64 x 4000): 99% self time in one inlined distance function. ASCII: 19 instructions per column (15 myers_step, 2 eq loads, 2 loop control), 98.5% of samples on the chain-end bic/orr/subs, eq loads ~0%. CJK: 22-25+ instructions per column (hash lookup + probe), myers block 51-57% of samples, the extra lookup work hides behind the same floor (2.13-2.20 ns/col vs 2.17 ASCII).
analysis.latency probe (experiments/latprobe, M2: and/orr/eor/bic/orn/eon/lsl #1/add: 1 cycle each; shifted-operand forms (orr x, y, x lsl #1): 2 cycles. Isolated blocks: chain6 7.50 cycles/col (const eq), 7.19 (table eq); chain5 7.65 / 7.47. The 6-op critical path alone: 6.0; plus 9 invariant ops: 6.2-6.3; plus 9 ops reading chain values: 6.6-6.9.
analysis.conclusion: The column loop is bound by scheduling of the myers block, not by the length of its critical path: off-chain ops that read chain values and become ready together delay the critical ops by ~1.5 cycles per column. Chain5's 3 extra ops and wider fan-out eat the saved cycle. Next search: fitness = probe cycles per column of the isolated block; targets are fan-out and instruction order, not op count.
